policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Maldives as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Maldivian passport holder travelling to Grenada as a short visitor.
The Embassy's live visitor page confirms requirements depend on citizenship; work, study, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document treatment remain outside scope.
The linked country schedule was updated April 2024; carrier checks, entry conditions and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Maldives in its no-visa-required cohort for short visitor stays.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Maldivian passport holder travelling to Panama as a short visitor; the Embassy states a maximum stay of three months for this cohort.
Passport validity, return travel, means of support, carrier checks and final admission remain separately required.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly identifies Maldives as eligible to obtain a visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Maldivian passport holder travelling to Jordan as a short visitor.
The official table says the visa can be obtained upon arrival and states a 40 JOD total charge.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Maldivian ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry page expressly permits ordinary Maldivian passport holders to obtain a multiple-entry eVisa online.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Maldivian passport holder travelling to Türkiye for tourism or commerce.
The Foreign Ministry says the electronic visa is available online as a three-month multiple-entry instrument; current portal requirements still apply.
Work, study, residence, transit, official passports, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Official Türkiye eVisa application
steps: Enter the requested identity, ordinary-passport and travel information in the official eVisa service.
Review the current eligibility conditions, pay the fee and obtain the issued eVisa before travel.
Carry the eVisa and supporting travel documents for carrier and border checks.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa on arrival, while Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry page directs ordinary Maldivian passport holders to obtain a multiple-entry eVisa online.
